mentions.name: Linked List
mentions.description: A link blog and curation site for discovering good reads suggested by fellow humans, positioned as an alternative to Hacker News and Lobsters. Sign-ups are not yet open.
mentions.problem: The author wants another option beyond Hacker News and Lobsters to find good reads suggested by fellow humans, anticipating that curation will become even more important.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building out a link blog idea called Linked List that I've wanted for a long time. Curation will be even more important in the future and I would love to have another option beyond Hacker News and Lobsters to find good reads suggested by fellow humans.
mentions.author: duck
